title: Bob Beck at Ossining during the space kids experiments
summary: Unnamed guest tells of Bob Beck at Ossining during the space kids experiments, about 1970s at Ossining, New York, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the story, like this guy Bob Beck, who was who was most certainly CIA, who was at the at Ossining at the time of these exact space kids experiments.

plain: An unnamed researcher, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, tells of a man named Bob Beck who, the guest says, was almost certainly working for the CIA, the US spy agency. According to the guest, Beck was in Ossining, New York, in the 1970s at the very time of the so-called space kids experiments, tests involving children said to have unusual contact abilities. The guest raises it to suggest the intelligence world was quietly watching that work.
